title: Mission body
description: A pooled goal with a shared reward on the log (register row DK1240, from DK813; spec-delta S1612): `mission` is its id, `goal_sha256` the hash of the goal text, `verifier` who decides whether the whole goal was met and records each contributor's share (a DID the log knows, or the operator), `closes_at` when funding ends. Funders put credits into the mission's pool (`mission_fund`), the verifier records contributions (`mission_contribution`), and `mission_settle` pays the pool by recorded shares if the goal was met, or returns each funder what it put in. The pool is an account of the society (did:web:asp.local:pool:mission-<id>): credits move, none are made or lost, and the credit audit holds. Refused: an id used twice (mission_known), an unknown verifier (mission_unknown_verifier), a closing time that is not in the future (mission_closes_in_past). Chain: none (prev is null).
